full_prompt_en: A gentle 3D character illustration shows two tiny, round white rabbit-like companions sitting shoulder to shoulder on a gray rock in an autumn meadow. Each body is a soft pear-shaped mound with short upright ears, little side paws, bead-black eyes, a small brown nose, and warm pink blush on the cheeks. Their forms are deliberately simple: there are no complicated joints or realistic anatomy, only plush silhouettes with charmingly minimal faces. The figure on the left leans slightly toward the one on the right, while the right figure faces back with a small raised paw, suggesting a quiet shared moment. Golden moss and fine reddish stalks surround the stone; fuzzy yellow shrubs blur across the lower-right foreground. Behind them, orange vegetation melts into a pale turquoise-blue sky with soft cloud streaks. The main bodies occupy the middle of the frame and are large enough to reveal fine, short velvety fibers across their surfaces. Warm low sunlight from the left rim-lights the ears, rounds the cream-white backs, and warms the pink cheeks. Cool blue fill light enters from the sky, leaving the undersides gently shaded without harsh black. The background falls quickly out of focus, and small near-ground plants appear as soft color clusters rather than sharply isolated specimens. A restrained pastel palette of ivory, blush, honey, coral, dusty purple, and sky blue makes the scene friendly and airy. The rock gives the pair a solid perch, while the wide open sky above their ears lends extra breathing room. The overall image feels like a carefully lit plush miniature outdoors, with tactile softness and a calm companionship at its center.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅温柔的三维角色插画表现两只小小的圆滚滚白色兔样伙伴，在秋日草地的灰石上肩靠肩坐着。每个身体都是柔软梨形团块，带短竖耳、小侧爪、黑珠眼、小褐鼻及双颊暖粉红晕。形体刻意简洁：没有复杂关节或写实解剖，只有绒软剪影和讨喜的极简面孔。左边角色微微靠向右边，右边回望并轻抬一只小爪，像分享安静片刻。金色苔藓与细红褐茎围绕石头；毛茸茸黄色灌木在右下前景化为模糊色团。两者身后，橙色植被融入浅青蓝天空和柔云纹。主角占据画面中部，体量足够大，表面短而细的丝绒纤维清晰可见。左侧低位暖阳给耳朵镶光，塑圆奶油白背部，并温暖粉红脸颊。天空的冷蓝补光进入，使下侧柔和成影而不发硬黑。背景迅速失焦，近地小植物变成柔色簇而非锐利孤立的物种。象牙、淡粉、蜂蜜、珊瑚、灰紫和天蓝组成克制粉彩，让场景友好轻盈。岩石给两者坚实落点，耳上宽敞开阔天空则增添呼吸空间。整体像在户外精心打光的绒毛微缩模型，以可触的柔软和安静陪伴为中心。
style_prompt_en: Soft 3D miniature illustration favors rounded pearlike volumes, very short velvety fibers, and pared-down facial marks. Creamy ivory forms carry small blush-pink patches and tiny dark points, set among fuzzy honey, coral, and dusty-purple ground clusters beneath a pale cyan sky. Warm low side light gives plush edges a fine luminous rim and gently grades the curved surfaces; cool fill keeps shaded areas light and friendly. The focal volumes remain sharply tactile, while foreground and background vegetation dissolve into shallow-depth-of-field color softness. Silhouettes are uncomplicated and generous, with small upright extensions adding a playful vertical beat. Two neighboring masses form a quiet central rhythm, balanced by a solid textured base below and broad airy negative space above. The overall finish is polished yet cozy, emphasizing touchable material, pastel harmony, and calm visual simplicity.
style_prompt_zh: 柔和三维微缩插画偏爱圆浑梨形体积、极短丝绒纤维和简化的面部点线。奶油象牙形体带小块淡粉红晕和微小暗点，周围是蜂蜜、珊瑚与灰紫毛茸茸地面簇群，上方为浅青天空。低位暖侧光给绒软边缘纤细光圈，并柔和渐变弯曲表面；冷补光让阴面依然明快友好。焦点体量保持清晰可触，前后景植被则在浅景深里溶成柔软颜色。剪影简洁而饱满，小型竖向突出形体添一拍俏皮节奏。两个相邻大块组成安静中心韵律，下方坚实纹理基底与上方宽阔空气留白平衡。整体收拾光洁却舒适，强调可触材料、粉彩和谐与安静视觉简约。
theme_en: Two round white rabbit-like companions sit together among golden autumn shrubs
theme_zh: 两只圆滚滚的白兔伙伴依偎在金色秋灌木间
name: Molang
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
